attributes.title: Sentinel-2 LAI - S2A_MSIL2A_20251030T104211_N0511_R008_T31TEJ_20251030T144716
attributes.source: ESA SNAP S2ToolBox BiophysicalOp neural network algorithm applied to Sentinel-2 L2A (S2A) bottom-of-atmosphere reflectances at 20 m resolution. Input bands: B03, B04, B05, B06, B07, B8A, B11, B12 + illumination/viewing geometry cosines.
attributes.history: 2026-04-17T12:37:44Z: LAI computed using ESA SNAP S2ToolBox BiophysicalOp neural network algorithm. Source product: https:/objects.eodc.eu:443/e05ab01a9d56408d82ac32d69a5aae2a:202510-s02msil2a-eu/30/products/cpm_v262/S2A_MSIL2A_20251030T104211_N0511_R008_T31TEJ_20251030T144716.zarr (sensing time: 2025-10-30T10:42:11Z, tile: T31TEJ). Sensor: S2A, spatial resolution: 20 m. Input reflectance bands (bottom-of-atmosphere, BOA reflectance): B03, B04, B05, B06, B07, B8A, B11, B12. Additional NN inputs: cosine of mean view zenith angle, cosine of sun zenith angle, cosine of relative azimuth angle (sun minus view). Viewing angles: per-band bilinear interpolation of 23x23 geometry grids from EOPF product conditions/geometry group, merged using per-detector footprint masks, then averaged across all input bands. Sun angles: bilinear interpolation of 23x23 geometry grids. Reflectance values read from measurements/reflectance/r20m group. Two-layer neural network: tanh hidden layer (5 neurons), linear output, with min-max normalisation / denormalisation from ESA S2ToolBox coefficient files (processing baseline N0511). Input validated against definition domain (stage 1: per-band min-max; stage 2: convex hull grid). Output validated against extreme-cases thresholds.
attributes.references: Weiss, M., Baret, F. (2016). S2ToolBox Level 2 products: LAI, FAPAR, FCOVER. Algorithm Theoretical Basis Document (ATBD), ESA. https://step.esa.int/docs/extra/ATBD_S2ToolBox_V1.1.pdf
attributes.comment: Leaf Area Index (LAI) is defined as half the developed area of photosynthetically active elements of the vegetation per unit horizontal ground area.
